content: The title of the page should be formatted as (Disease name) symptoms, with only the first letter of the title capitalized. The purpose of this page is to describe the typical symptoms that a patient reports. It is important to note that symptoms are distinct from signs, which are clinical findings observed by physicians. At the top of the edit box, include the {{CMG}} template, your name template, and the microchapter navigation template that you created earlier. When creating links within Wikidoc, enclose key terms in brackets to link them to other pages. For instance, if the text mentions anterior spinal artery syndrome, the link should direct to anterior spinal artery syndrome rather than generic terms like anterior, artery, or syndrome. For further guidance on creating links, refer to the instructions provided. Follow the formatting and capitalization guidelines outlined in the template. Additionally, include the name of the disease in the first sentence of every subsection. In the overview section, the disease name should appear in the first sentence. This section aims to summarize the history and symptoms page in a few sentences. It can be identical to the history and symptoms segment found on the overview page. For an example, refer to the provided link. If the disease has a single, particularly identifiable symptom, use statements such as: The hallmark of [disease] is [symptom]. A positive history of [symptom] and [symptom] is suggestive of [disease]. The most common symptoms of [disease] include [symptom], [symptom], and [symptom]. If the disease has multiple equally recognizable symptoms, use statements such as: Symptoms of [disease] include [symptom], [symptom], and [symptom]. If it is appropriate to distinguish between common and less common symptoms, use the following format: On the overview page, write full sentences: Common symptoms of [disease] include [symptom], [symptom], and [symptom]. Less common symptoms of [disease] include [symptom], [symptom], and [symptom]. On the History and Symptoms microchapter, use bullet points: Common symptoms of [disease] include: [Symptom] [Symptom] [Symptom] Less common symptoms of [disease] include: [Symptom] [Symptom] [Symptom] If symptoms are typically absent, use statements such as: The majority of patients with [disease] are asymptomatic. In the History section, describe the key components of the patient’s history that require particular attention. This includes relevant details from the past medical history, family history, social history (such as occupational history, alcohol use with specific amounts and frequency, smoking, and drug use), and allergies. This section is not intended to describe the natural history of the disease or its historical background. For an example of a history section, refer to the provided link. In the Common Symptoms section, list the symptoms that patients most frequently experience. For an example of this section, refer to the provided link. In the Less Common Symptoms section, list the symptoms that patients may experience less frequently. For an example of this section, refer to the provided link.
